Level up From Organic to Regenerative Farming
Today, All Coco proudly sources from more than 3,400 Rais ( 544 
Hectare) certified organic farms.
By 2027 , we aim to further strengthen our sustainability journey 
by transitioning 50% of our network toward Regenerative Organic 
Farming (ROC) .
This shift will be driven through collaboration with global partners 
and a deeper focus on soil health —including practices such as 
cover cropping, crop rotation, and diverse planting.
